## Summary
- Document that `isAuthorized` returns false for a malformed policy ID, after clearing the invert flag.
- Separate that from empty-set semantics for a well-formed unknown ID, and state that an inverted ID is negated only when the base exists.

## Test plan
- [ ] Confirm the NatSpec matches `MockPolicyRegistry._isAuthorized` for malformed, unknown, and inverted IDs.
- [ ] `forge test -vv --match-test test_isAuthorized_success_invertUnknown`
